name: Shaker Care App
desc: A React Native mobile application for Shaker Group that enables customers to request product services and installations, submit complaints, explore and purchase products, and connect with customer support through WhatsApp.

name: Vibe App
desc: A cross-platform React Native shopping application developed for PSO petrol stations, enabling customers to browse and order convenience-store products through self-pickup or home delivery. The app provides location-based store selection and supports multiple payment options, including Cash on Delivery and DigiCash. Built with React Native, Redux, JavaScript, and Firebase to deliver a smooth and scalable mobile shopping experience across Android and iOS.

name: Blue App
desc: A mobile LPG delivery and order-management application built to digitize the customer ordering experience. The app supports LPG cylinder ordering, recurring subscription management, real-time order tracking, delivery status updates, and account management, providing a streamlined solution for customers and delivery operations.

name: Vibe Web Portal
desc: VIBE is a comprehensive retail and e-commerce management platform designed to manage the complete lifecycle of convenience-store operations. The web-based admin dashboard provides centralized management of products, stores, orders, customers, discounts, vouchers, complaints, transactions, partnerships, banners, and store feedback. It also includes real-time business analytics with revenue tracking, monthly sales trends, sales growth, top-performing products, and customer/order statistics, enabling administrators to monitor and optimize overall store performance.

name: Neuconnect - Master Oil
desc: A comprehensive warehouse Track & Trace management system designed to streamline production, inventory, warehouse, and dispatch operations. The platform enables organizations to monitor production lines, manage production orders, track bottles, cartons and pallets, assign warehouses and handling units, generate barcodes, and manage sales and delivery orders. It provides centralized operational dashboards with real-time production, warehouse, and dispatch metrics, helping teams maintain end-to-end visibility and traceability across the supply chain.

name: QBS Website
desc: A modern responsive corporate website for QBS Co., showcasing its digital transformation services, AI and automation solutions, enterprise technologies, products, clients, and global capabilities. Built with React, Next.js, JavaScript, Material UI, and Bootstrap.

name: NOQ Website
desc: NOQ is a virtual queue and appointment management platform designed to eliminate physical waiting and streamline service access. The platform allows users to book appointments, join virtual queues, track their position and estimated waiting time, and receive appointment alerts. It supports multiple service industries including healthcare, public facilitation centers, embassies, entertainment, lifestyle services, and event management.

name: Nodejs-Mono-to-Micro-Architecture
desc: Microservices-based architecture. Webhooks, RabbitMQ, Docker, CI/CD, RabbitMQ, Sentry
